item.title: Ribbon cut on Millbrook’s newest restaurant
item.description: The new location is the 7th across the state and has brought over 35 full and part time jobs to the community.

item.title: Savannah Guthrie’s family renews plea to mother’s kidnapper, while sheriff says they have no suspect
item.description: Five days into the desperate search for 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie, authorities have not identified any suspects or persons of interest.

item.title: What The Tech: Does reporting spam texts actually work?
item.description: For many of us, seeing an unknown number pop up triggers an automatic reflex: hit "mark as spam" and move on. But what really happens after you tap that button? And is there a better way to deal with scam messages?

item.title: Auburn police arrest two teenagers on multiple charges, including theft
item.description: The thefts occurred in and around the 700 block of West Magnolia Avenue.

item.title: State surplus property auction begins online this weekend
item.description: The auction will feature a wide array of items, including vehicles, bicycles, electronics and much more.

item.title: Alabama sets execution for man in auto parts store customer’s death
item.description: Alabama has scheduled a March execution date for a man sentenced to death for a fatal shooting during a 1991 robbery.
